globals.name: D3DX_InitPSGP
globals.source: reads registry DisableD3DXPSGP, tests CPU features 7/10/6, fills the 57-entry math table at 0x7af8e0 (REA ev_2a517d4a)

globals.name: D3DX_ReadRegistryDword
globals.source: called as (4, "DisableD3DXPSGP", &value, 4) by D3DX_InitPSGP; references Software\Microsoft\Direct3D

globals.name: D3DX_HasCpuFeature
globals.source: called with 7, 10, 6 (IsProcessorFeaturePresent codes: 3DNow!, SSE2, SSE) by D3DX_InitPSGP

globals.name: D3DX_PSGP_SetSSE
globals.source: chosen for feature 6 (SSE); stores SSE routines 0x42dce0.. into the table (REA ev_affe92c6)

globals.name: D3DX_PSGP_Set3DNow
globals.source: chosen for feature 7 (3DNow!); stores 3DNow! routines 0x430e69.. into the table

globals.name: g_D3DXPSGPTable
globals.source: 57 math function pointers used by D3DX at runtime

globals.name: g_D3DXPSGPTableDefault
globals.source: x87 defaults copied into g_D3DXPSGPTable by D3DX_InitPSGP
